purpose: Predict the frozen retrieval-conditioned context-sufficiency target using leakage-safe inference-time features; freeze a selective retrieval-expansion policy without generation.

excluded: DEV_Q066 under the frozen semantic input-budget rule
TRAIN_Q526 under the frozen semantic input-budget rule

feature_registry.retrieval_strategy: inference-available categorical predictor with fixed one-hot levels bm25,dense,hybrid

feature_computation.query_character_count: Python Unicode code-point length of the unmodified question string
feature_computation.digit_token_definition: normalized lexical token for which str.isdigit() is true
feature_computation.fraction_zero_denominator: 0.0 only when the mathematical denominator is an empty token set

idf.source: the frozen Phase 2 rank_bm25.BM25Okapi cache idf dictionary for in-vocabulary tokens
idf.in_vocabulary_values: exact cached Phase 2 values, including rank_bm25 epsilon adjustment for negative raw IDF
idf.out_of_vocabulary_formula: ln((N + 0.5) / 0.5), using frozen Phase 2 corpus size N and df=0
idf.coverage_denominator: sum of IDF weights over unique query tokens

feature_computation.lexical_overlap: intersection size divided by unique query-token count

semantic_model.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
semantic_model.similarity: cosine via exact dot product of normalized float32 embeddings

retrieval_score_standardization.reason: BM25, dense cosine, and RRF scores are not globally comparable
retrieval_score_standardization.scope: each of the eight retrieval-score columns separately within retrieval_strategy
retrieval_score_standardization.formula: (x - TRAIN-strategy mean) / TRAIN-strategy population standard deviation
retrieval_score_standardization.fit_scope: analysis TRAIN only; refit on each inner-CV training fold

feature_computation.cross_retriever_agreement: set overlap and Jaccard of frozen BM25 and dense top-k chunk-id lists for the same question and k

preprocessing.continuous_missing_values: median imputation fitted on TRAIN only with missing-indicator columns for features having missing values at fit time
preprocessing.undefined_quantities: IEEE NaN in the feature artifact before preprocessing
preprocessing.categorical: fixed one-hot encoding for retrieval_strategy levels bm25,dense,hybrid; unknown levels fail
preprocessing.logistic_regression_scaling: StandardScaler fitted after imputation on TRAIN only
preprocessing.random_forest_scaling: none after the identical score-normalization and imputation semantics

B4.name: calibrated_selected_random_forest
B4.oof_source: 5-fold grouped TRAIN predictions from selected B3 hyperparameters
B4.sigmoid_mapping: LogisticRegression(C=1000000, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=5000, random_state=42) on one raw-probability column
selection: uncalibrated permitted if calibration worsens both

ece.empty_bins: persist with count 0 and null empirical quantities

bootstrap.duplicate_group_handling: include every condition row once per sampled occurrence of its question

feature_analysis.logistic_regression: signed standardized coefficients ranked by absolute magnitude
feature_analysis.random_forest: VALIDATION permutation importance using AUPRC scoring, 30 repeats, random seed 42

ablations.metadata_handling: retrieval_strategy and k appear only in D/full; A-C contain only their named evidence families

risk_coverage.coverage: answered eligible conditions / all eligible conditions
risk_coverage.selective_risk: answered conditions with y_suff_final=0 / all answered conditions
risk_coverage.curve_thresholds: all distinct selected-model VALIDATION probabilities in descending order, preceded by nextafter(max_probability,+infinity) and followed by 0.0 if absent; ties enter together
risk_coverage.aurc: right-endpoint rectangular integration over ascending coverage, with origin (coverage=0,risk=NA) omitted from area and each observed risk applied over its coverage increment

sensitivity_analysis.timing: only after primary feature architecture, model, calibration, and policy are frozen
sensitivity_analysis.change: add benchmark-impossible preliminary-negative rows to TRAIN

test_seal.guard: any Phase 4 request whose split equals TEST fails before reading target rows or producing features, probabilities, metrics, summaries, importance, risk-coverage, or policy outputs

governance.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over physical bytes for each file and SHA-256 over canonical JSON for the modeling configuration
governance.methodology_change_after_validation: forbidden; implementation defects require documentation and STOP for review
